portInfo.description: Punta Arenas is the Magallanes gateway for Patagonia and Antarctic repositioning itineraries. Empresa Portuaria Austral completed Stage II works at Muelle Arturo Prat in 2025 to raise direct-berth capacity from 258 m to 300 m LOA on the south face, adding a third dolphin, mooring gear and passenger walkway elements intended to reduce tendering for large ships. EPAUSTRAL also describes a forthcoming Stage III and a new passenger terminal project. Exact passenger-door coordinates and current tender-vs-dock rules by LOA remain null beyond the LOA statements.
